name: xTool F2
tagline: 2025 portable galvo — 15W diode + 5W IR with 50MP camera
tldr: xTool F2 (2025) upgrades the F1 formula with more power, a 50MP alignment camera, and up to 6,000 mm/s galvo speed. Dual-source (diode + infrared) for metal marking and organics in a compact box — xTool Studio only, no LightBurn.
mainObjective: Fast portable dual-laser for on-site customization and small-batch metal + wood

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Major F1 upgrade — more power and camera
Strong for fairs and on-site engraving
cons: F2 Ultra exists for production metal shops
Premium over F1 for hobby-only users
beginnerNotes: Pick F2 over F1 if you sell personalized metal goods or need camera batch alignment. Wood-only hobbyists may prefer D1 Pro or S1 for bed size per dollar.
proTips: Use conveyor accessory for tags and flat blanks. Keep IR and diode material libraries separate — power curves are not interchangeable.
primaryUse: 2025 compact galvo for high-speed metal marking plus light organic engraving and cutting.

moduleSystem.headline: 15W diode + 5W infrared (1064 nm)
moduleSystem.description: Fixed dual-source galvo — switch between diode for organics and IR for bare metal marking in xTool Studio.
